# Costa's Meat Market

> Davenport, Florida's premier neighborhood butcher shop, fresh meat market, and specialty grocery store. Real butchers, custom fresh cuts, picanha, family bundles, weekly specials, and authentic Latin & Brazilian cuts.

## Business Details
- **Name**: Costa's Meat Market
- **Type**: Butcher Shop, Meat Market, Grocery Store
- **Address**: 2169 Davenport Blvd, Davenport, FL 33837, United States
- **Phone**: +1 (863) 422-2313
- **Primary Website**: https://costasmeatmarket.com/
- **Online Ordering**: https://costasmeatmarket.hrpos.heartland.us/
- **Social Links & Community**: https://costasmeatmarket.com/socials/
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/share/1BqfQyWrdy/
- **Instagram**: @costasmeat
- **TikTok**: @costasmeat

## Offerings & Specialties
- **Fresh Custom Meat Cuts**: Hand-trimmed beef, pork, poultry, and specialty meats by experienced butchers.
- **Picanha & Specialty Cuts**: High-grade picanha drops, churrasco cuts, ribs, and Latin/Brazilian favorite cuts.
- **Family Meat Bundles**: Cost-saving combo packages with assorted cuts for family meals and barbecues.
- **Weekly Specials & Coupons**: Regular discount drops announced on WhatsApp community channels and social media.
- **Butcher Counter Service**: Call ahead or order at the counter for custom thicknesses, marinades, and preparation.

## Key Navigation Links
- [Online Store / Pickup Orders](https://costasmeatmarket.hrpos.heartland.us/): Place orders online for easy counter pickup.
- [Community Hub & Socials](https://costasmeatmarket.com/socials/): WhatsApp group, WhatsApp announcement channel, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
